subject: Re: FieldForge x Redwood: Hands-on Lab Day — partner logistics & content
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita@fieldforge.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: events@fieldforge.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: FieldForge x Redwood: Hands-on Lab Day proposal

Hi Rishi,

Quick intro — I head partnerships at FieldForge. We run a regional ‘Hands-on Lab Day’ series for ISVs and platform customers (open to ~120 devs/infra folks). Would Redwood be interested in co-hosting a 90-minute session focused on "Inference at Scale: deploying and optimizing LLMs in production"?

High level ask: one 25–30 minute keynote/demo (engineer + product), a 45-minute hands-on breakout (small groups with guided exercises), and a 10–15 minute lightning panel on cost/observability. We’d promote jointly across our lists, social, and a partner blog post.

Proposed dates: May 22 or June 5 (San Francisco). I attached a short proposal with logistics.

If this sounds interesting I can loop in Samir (events) and share a draft SOW.

Best,
Anita Shah
Head of Partnerships, FieldForge
attachments: FieldForge_Redwood_Proposal_v1.pdf

---
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita@fieldforge.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FieldForge x Redwood: Hands-on Lab Day proposal

Anita — thanks for reaching out, this looks promising. Redwood is interested. Quick answers up front:
- We can commit a senior systems engineer for the demo + a product lead for the keynote (happy to draft speaker names once logistics are locked).
- May 22 works better for us but can do June 5 if you need the window.
- We’ll need a co-promo timeline and a list of what you need from us (deck, sample datasets, VM/container images for the breakout).

Laura: can you help with AV/booth and confirm whether we need to bring any special hardware for the hands-on labs?
Marissa: can you own the promo commitments and suggested copy?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0112

---
From: Anita Shah <anita@fieldforge.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@forgeworld.co>, events@fieldforge.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T13:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FieldForge x Redwood: Hands-on Lab Day proposal

Great — thanks Rishi. Quick details from our side:
- We’ll handle venue AV, basic Wi‑Fi, and 40 laptops for the hands-on pods. Hosts will provide step-by-step exercises; we typically ask partners to provide a pre-built container image (Docker) that participants can pull.
- Promotion plan: two joint emails (3 weeks and 1 week out), social cadence (3 posts each org), and a co-authored blog post to publish the week after the event.
- Partner SOW: standard revenue share for paid tickets (we split net), booth space, and 3 partner mentions in the opening remarks. Draft SOW attached.

I attached the proposal and SOW draft. Can the demo run within a standard laptop/container environment (no GPU requirement), or do you need a cloud-backed instance?

Thanks — looping Samir for logistics and Marissa for promo details.

-Anita
Attachments: SOW-draft-fieldforge-redwood.docx

---
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita@fieldforge.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FieldForge x Redwood: Hands-on Lab Day proposal

Anita / team — Laura here from Events. Logistics notes:
- AV/booth: we’ll take one 6ft table and request a tabletop monitor for the demo. Please confirm monitor size and HDMI/USB-C.
- Hands-on: If you provide the 40 laptops, can you also pre-load the container or give a pull spec and a quick network whitelist? Our attendees are mostly cloud‑based engineers; if you want to run CPU-only containers that’s preferred to avoid GPU complexity.
- Branding: we’ll need co-branded slide templates and a partner logo in your homepage hero by May 8 to make the email. Can you share asset specs?

I’ll add this event to Redwood’s events calendar and request travel for our engineer.

Laura Bennett
Events Lead, Redwood Inference

---
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Shah <anita@fieldforge.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-03T10:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FieldForge x Redwood: Hands-on Lab Day proposal

Thanks — happy to own promo. Quick promo checklist and asks:
- Deliverables we’ll provide: co-branded email copy (two sends), 3 social posts (LinkedIn/X), a short blog draft (800–1,000 words), and a 30s promo video (static slides + voiceover).
- We’ll need: speaker names + bios, 2–3 screenshots from the demo, and a lead capture form spec (fields + redirect).
- Timeline: Share final assets by May 8. We'll run the first email 3 weeks out (May 1) and a reminder one week out (May 15) if May 22 is the date.

On costs: we typically expect marketing and ticket revenue splits to be in the SOW. If FieldForge wants to offer Redwood a set number of comp codes for customers, we can coordinate with CS for follow-up.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

---
From: Anita Shah <anita@fieldforge.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@forgeworld.co>, events@fieldforge.ai
Date: 2028-04-05T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FieldForge x Redwood: Hands-on Lab Day proposal — files and next steps

Perfect — thanks everyone. Attaching the SOW and a short promo spec PDF with logo sizes and social copy limits.

Answers: the demo will run CPU-only with a lightweight container (no GPU). We’ll send the container image tag and a public registry link by April 12.

Next steps:
1) Review SOW and confirm revenue/ticket split by April 10.
2) Share speaker names, bios, and one demo screenshot by April 12.
3) Final assets delivered by May 8 for co-branded email.

I attached: SOW-draft-fieldforge-redwood.docx, promo_assets_specs.pdf. Samir will follow up on booth specifics next week.

Thanks — excited to partner on this!
Anita Shah
Head of Partnerships, FieldForge
